ns2:course.label: Graduate Jazz Piano
ns2:course.description: Instruction at the graduate level in jazz piano normally associated with the jazz idiom. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 20 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for the appropriate jazz faculty.
